titles.de: An dich in 2000 Jahren – Der Fall von Shiganshina, Teil 1
titles.en: To You, 2000 Years in the Future: The Fall of Zhiganshina (1)
titles.es: A ti, dentro de 2000 años. La caída de Shiganshina (Parte 1)
titles.fr: À toi qui vis 2000 ans plus tard
titles.ja: 二千年後の君へ シガンシナ陥落①
titles.x-jat: Nisen-nengo no Kimi e: Shiganshina Kanraku (1)

description: After one hundred years of peace, humanity is suddenly reminded of the terror of being at the Titans' mercy.

titles.de: An jenem Tag – Der Fall von Shiganshina, Teil 2
titles.en: That Day: The Fall of Zhiganshina (2)
titles.es: Aquel día. La caída de Shiganshina (Parte 2)
titles.fr: Ce jour-là ~2) La chute de Shiganshina~
titles.ja: その日 シガンシナ陥落②

description: After the Titans break through the wall, the citizens of Shiganshina must run for their lives. However, those that do make it to safety find a harsh life waiting for them.

titles.de: Ein fahles Licht inmitten der Verzweiflung – Die Rückkehr der Menschheit, Teil 1
titles.en: A Dim Light in the Darkness of Despair: Humanity Rises Again (1)
titles.es: Una tenue luz en la desesperación. La restauración de la humanidad (Parte 1)
titles.fr: Une faible étincelle dans le désespoir ~Le réveil de l`humanité~
titles.ja: 絶望の中で鈍く光る 人類の再起①
titles.x-jat: Zetsubou no Naka de Nibuku Hikaru: Jinrui no Saiki (1)

description: Eren begins his training with the Cadet Corps, but questions about his painful past overwhelm him. When he struggles with a maneuvering exercise, Bertholdt and Reiner offer kindly advice.

titles.de: Die Nacht der Abschlusszeremonie – Die Rückkehr der Menschheit, Teil 2
titles.en: Night of the Graduation Ceremony: Humanity Rises Again (2)
titles.es: La noche de la desbandada. La restauración de la humanidad (Parte 2)
titles.fr: Le soir de la cérémonie de fin d`entraînement ~Le réveil de l`humanité~
titles.ja: 解散式の夜 人類の再起②
titles.x-jat: Kaisanshiki no Yoru: Jinrui no Saiki (2)

description: Two years pass and the time for the recruits' graduation approaches. Annie proves her skill in a sparring session, Jean dreams of serving alongside the King, and graduation day brings shocking revelations — along with the sudden appearance of an old foe.

titles.de: Feuertaufe – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 1
titles.en: First Battle: Battle of Trost (1)
titles.es: La primera batalla. La defensa de Trost (Parte 1)
titles.fr: Première bataille ~La lutte pour le district Trost~
titles.ja: 初陣 トロスト区攻防戦①

description: Five years have passed since the fall of Wall Maria and Eren faces off against the Colossal Titan after it appears out of nowhere once again, and knocks a strategic hole in the gate of Wall Rose. As Titans swarm the city, the newly graduated Cadets are called in to fight a brutal battle that won't be without casualties.

titles.de: Die Welt durch die Augen eines Mädchens – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 2
titles.en: The World the Girl Saw: Battle for Trost (2)
titles.es: El mundo que ella vio. La defensa de Trost (Parte 2)
titles.fr: Une petite lame ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
titles.ja: 少女が見た世界 トロスト区攻防戦②
titles.x-jat: Shoujo ga Mita Sekai: Trost-ku Koubousen (2)

description: Armin tries to cope with the loss of his friends and allies after Titans massacre his squad. Elsewhere in the city, Mikasa manages to take out several of the monsters, which brings back tragic memories of her past and the first time she met Eren.

titles.de: Eine kleine Klinge – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 3
titles.en: The Small Blade: The Battle for Trost (3)
titles.es: Una pequeña hoja. La defensa de Trost (Parte 3)
titles.fr: Courte lame ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
titles.ja: 小さな刃 トロスト区攻防戦③

description: After the retreat bell sounds, many cadets find themselves without enough fuel to scale the wall back to safety. Mikasa begins to lose hope once she hears of the deaths in Armin's squad, but the appearance of a new type of Titan stokes her will to fight.

titles.de: Ich kann seinen Herzschlag hören – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 4
titles.en: Hearing the Heartbeat: The Battle for Trost (4)
titles.es: Se escucha un latido. La defensa de Trost (Parte 4)
titles.fr: J`entends les battements de ton cœur ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
titles.ja: 心臓の鼓動が聞こえる トロスト区攻防戦④
titles.x-jat: Shinzou no Kodou ga Kikoeru: Trost-ku Koubousen (4)

description: Armin comes up with a risky plan that pits Titan against Titan as the abandoned cadets attempt to take back their headquarters. Getting into the building might be possible, but getting out alive and refueled will mean facing more of the giants.

titles.de: Der Verbleib des linken Arms – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 5
titles.en: Where the Left Arm Went: The Battle for Trost (5)
titles.es: Dónde está el brazo izquierdo. La defensa de Trost (Parte 5)
titles.fr: Qu`est-il advenu du bras gauche ? ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
titles.ja: 左腕の行方 トロスト区攻防戦⑤
titles.x-jat: Hidari Ude no Yukue: Trost-ku Koubousen (5)

description: A miraculous return is met with anger and fear. Cannons are fixed on Eren as he struggles to remember what happened to him inside the belly of a Titan and how he ended up as humankind's enemy. One question is all that matters: is Eren human or Titan?

titles.de: Die Reaktion – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 6
titles.en: Response: The Battle for Trost (6)
titles.es: Respuesta. La defensa de Trost (Parte 6)
titles.fr: Répondre ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
titles.ja: 応える トロスト区攻防戦⑥

description: Cadets respond to Eren's terrifying transformation with doubt and fear as he struggles to understand it himself. If Armin can't talk the commander into using Eren's newfound powers for the good of humankind, all hope of stopping the Titans might be lost.

titles.de: Das Idol – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 7
titles.en: Icon: The Battle for Trost (7)
titles.es: Ídolo. La defensa de Trost (Parte 7)
titles.fr: Idole ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
titles.ja: 偶像 トロスト区攻防戦⑦

description: Plans are made to use Eren's Titan powers to seal the hole in the wall in an attempt reclaim Trost. But with the government's bloodstained history and vocal dissenters in the military ranks, the biggest threat to humankind may not be the Titans.

titles.de: Die Wunde – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 8
titles.en: Wound: The Battle for Trost (8)
titles.es: Herida. La defensa de Trost (Parte 8)
titles.fr: Blessure ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
titles.ja: 傷 トロスト区攻防戦⑧

description: The plan to reclaim Trost falls apart when Eren’s newfound powers turn him into a mindless giant. As Titans continue to swarm the city, it’s up to Armin and Mikasa to make sure the cadets massacred during the mission haven’t died in vain.

titles.de: Urtrieb – Schlacht um den Bezirk Trost, Teil 9
titles.en: Primal Desires: The Battle for Trost (9)
titles.es: Deseos primarios. La defensa de Trost (Parte 9)
titles.fr: Désir primitif ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
titles.ja: 原初的欲求 トロスト区攻防戦⑨

description: Jean takes desperate measures to replace his broken Maneuver Gear. Meanwhile, Eren is able to seal the hole in the wall thanks to the help of his fellow cadets, but the cost of humanity’s first victory against the Titans will be enormous.

titles.de: Noch nicht fähig, in die Augen zu sehen – Am Vorabend der Gegenoffensive, Teil 1
titles.en: Still Can`t See: Night Before the Counteroffensive (1)
titles.es: Sigo sin poder ver. Preludio a la contraofensiva (Parte 1)
titles.fr: On ne peut pas le regarder dans les yeux ~La lutte pour le district de Trost~
titles.ja: まだ目を見れない 反撃前夜①
titles.x-jat: Mada Me o Mirenai: Hangeki Zen`ya (1)

description: A special military tribunal will decide Eren’s fate. The Military Police calls for his execution while the Recon Corps argues that he is a powerful resource for humankind, and Mikasa is put on the spot when asked about the events of the Trost mission.

titles.de: Spezialkommando – Am Vorabend der Gegenoffensive, Teil 2
titles.en: Special Ops Squad: Night Before the Counteroffensive (2)
titles.es: El escuadrón de operaciones especiales. Preludio a la contraofensiva (Parte 2)
titles.fr: Unité d`intervention ~La veille de la contre-attaque~
titles.ja: 特別作戦班 反撃前夜②

description: The Recon Corps moves Eren to an old abandoned castle where he will continue his training. Hanzi visits and reveals that she’s been putting two captured Titans through a series of tests and trials — experiments that she wants Eren’s help with.

titles.de: Was getan werden muss – Am Vorabend der Gegenoffensive, Teil 3
titles.en: What Should Be Done: Night Before the Counteroffensive (3)
titles.es: ¿Y ahora qué hacemos?. Preludio a la contraofensiva (Parte 3)
titles.fr: Ce qu`il faut faire maintenant ~La veille de la contre-attaque~
titles.ja: 今, 何をすべきか 反撃前夜③
titles.x-jat: Ima, Nani o Subeki ka: Hangeki Zen`ya (3)

description: Everyone is a suspect in the investigation to find out who killed the two test-subject Titans. Meanwhile, the cadets pick which military branch they’ll be joining, but after the harrowing events in the Trost attack, many are uncertain which branch to choose.

titles.de: Der weibliche Titan – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 1
titles.en: Female Titan: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (1)
titles.es: El titán hembra. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 1)
titles.fr: Le titan féminin ~ La 57e expédition extra-muros ~
titles.ja: 女型の巨人 第57回壁外調査①
titles.x-jat: Megata no Kyojin: Dai 57 Kai Hekigai Chousa (1)

description: As the Recon Corps begins its push toward Shiganshina, they encounter an intelligent Female Titan unlike any they’ve seen before. When Armin hypothesizes that it’s really a human that’s been turned into a Titan, he, Jean, and Reiner attempt to stop it.

titles.de: Der Wald der Baumriesen – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 2
titles.en: Forest of Giant Trees: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (2)
titles.es: El bosque de los árboles gigantes. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 2)
titles.fr: La forêt des arbres géants: La 57e expédition extra-muros
titles.ja: 巨大樹の森 第57回壁外調査②
titles.x-jat: Kyodaiju no Mori: Dai 57 Kai Hekigai Chousa (2)

description: As the Female Titan continues to tear its way through the Recon Corps, Levi makes a bold decision to split the ranks and send Eren and the supply wagons through a huge forest. Is his strategy genius, or does it spell certain death for the scouts?

titles.de: Der Biss – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 3
titles.en: Bite: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (3)
titles.es: Mordisco. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 3)
titles.fr: Morsure: La 57e expédition extra-muros
titles.ja: 噛みつく 第57回壁外調査③

description: With the Female Titan still chasing after Levi's squad, Eren considers turning himself into his Titan form, but Levi tells him to choose to be either a monster or a member of the Recon Corps. As Eren remembers what he has learned from the squad, he realizes that the danger and sacrifice they all share is not what binds them — it is trust. Now it is up to Eren to make the decision of who he will trust.

titles.de: Erwin Smith – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 4
titles.en: Erwin Smith: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (4)
titles.es: Erwin Smith. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 4)
titles.fr: Erwin Smith ~La 57e expédition extra-muros~
titles.ja: エルヴィン・スミス 第57回壁外調査④
titles.x-jat: Erwin Smith: Dai 57 Kai Hekigai Chousa (4)

description: With the help of Levi's squad, the Recon Corps has successfully captured the Female Titan. As Commander Erwin and Captain Levi begin preparations to extract whoever is inside the Titan, will the Recon Corps discover its true identity, or does the Female Titan have one last trick up its sleeve?

titles.de: Ein harter Schlag – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 5
titles.en: Crushing Blow: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (5)
titles.es: Golpe devastador. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 5)
titles.fr: Coup dur ~La 57e expédition extra-muros~
titles.ja: 鉄槌 第57回壁外調査⑤

description: After a last act of desperation, the person inside the Female Titan has escaped from the Recon Corps and reverted to their human form. Now, disguised as a member of the Recon Corps and equipped with Maneuver Gear, they finally catch up to their prey — Levi's squad.

titles.de: Die Besiegten – Die 57. Expedition hinter die Mauer, Teil 6
titles.en: The Defeated: 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls (6)
titles.es: El derrotado. 57ª expedición más allá de los muros (Parte 6)
titles.fr: Les vaincus ~La 57e expédition extra-muros~
titles.ja: 敗者達 第57回壁外調査⑥

description: The Female Titan has captured Eren after ripping him out of his Titan body, but Mikasa and Captain Levi give chase. Elsewhere, the Recon Corps begins preparations for the journey back home to the Wall with their numerous dead in tow.

titles.de: Das Lächeln – Sturm auf den Bezirk Stohess, Teil 1
titles.en: Smile: Raid on Stohess District (1)
titles.es: Sonrisa. Asalto en el Distrito Stohess (Parte 1)
titles.fr: Sourire ~Attaque surprise au district de Stohess~
titles.ja: 微笑み ストヘス区急襲①

description: Following the disastrous results of the 57th Expedition, Eren is to be brought to the King's palace for a court martial. Armin, desperate to save Eren from certain execution, enlists the help of an old friend to assist with an escape plan.

titles.de: Mitleid – Sturm auf den Bezirk Stohess, Teil 2
titles.en: Mercy: Raid on Stohess District (2)
titles.es: Piedad. Asalto en el Distrito Stohess (Parte 2)
titles.fr: Pitié ~Attaque surprise au district de Stohess~
titles.ja: 慈悲 ストヘス区急襲②

description: With the identity of the Female Titan now revealed, Eren has reservations about fighting her. Mikasa, Armin, and the rest of the Recon Corps try to fight the Female Titan, hoping to distract her long enough to buy Eren time to come to terms with his feelings.

titles.de: Die Mauer – Sturm auf den Bezirk Stohess, Teil 3
titles.en: The Wall: Raid on Stohess District (3)
titles.es: Muro. Asalto en el Distrito Stohess (Parte 3)
titles.fr: Mur ~Attaque surprise au district de Stohess~
titles.ja: 壁 ストヘス区急襲③

description: Eren, spurred on by his promise to kill every single Titan, unleashes the full power of his Titan form in the fight with the Female Titan. As their bloody battle draws to a close, it seems humanity may finally have a chance at survival. However, with many mysteries still left unsolved, what will await Eren, Mikasa, and Armin?
